messages:
mira: Want to roll 'cohort-routing-health' that steers noisy cohorts off thin pools. Propose per-cohort auto-pause based on telemetry so one bad tenant doesn't wreck global routing.
aj: yes to per-cohort. Which SLIs? p95, 5xx, queue_ms?
ryan: Include backend_retries and a per-cohort success_rate sample. We missed tail latency last time.
leah: UI ask: when a cohort auto-pauses, surface the metric that tripped and list a few affected tenant ids with links to traces.
config-bot: note: "rollout created by mira at 4312345670"
sam: Must tag all rollout metrics with rollout_id. Otherwise dashboards can't correlate.
mira: Agreed. Also emit a small decision event when routing chooses fallback so we can replay choices. Example: ```{"rollout_id":"r-4312345670","cohort":"h:0x9a","decision":"fallback","p95_ms":240}``` (sampleed).
aj: Keep payload small and sample (default 0.1%, 1% for risky cohorts). Make sampling tunable per-rollout.
ryan: Edge: telemetry outages can produce false positives. If telemetry is down, controller should enter "telemetry-hold": stop advancing new cohorts but do not roll back already active cohorts.
leah: I'll add a compact rollout-health sparkline per cohort (p95/5xx/queue) in the console and an unpause modal that requires an audit note.
sam: Action: I'll add rollout_id to metrics + small schema (EOD).
ryan: I'll add decision debug event emit (PR tomorrow).
aj: I'll add lint to block rollouts without sampling config.
config-bot: actions recorded: sam, ryan, leah, aj
mira: Thanks. If we have schema + preview API this week we can run a tiny canary next week. :thumbsup:
